script_text: Prepare for a massive emotional shift this week, Cancer, because the stars demand absolute truth. Monday through Wednesday, a tense Mars square your Moon in the Fourth House drains your Water element, making Tuesday your worst day. Your ruling planet feels trapped, amplifying deep fatigue across the home sector. Wednesday brings the crucial turning point as Venus enters your Seventh House, igniting a trine with your natal Jupiter in the First House. Thursday through Sunday, this transit transforms your career and money in the Tenth House, bringing a lucrative promotion. Your weekend offers a serene romantic reunion, soothing the pressure of the week. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your Seventh House, while Tuesday is your worst day due to Mars squaring your Fourth House Moon. Trust your intuition to navigate these tides and release lingering resentments about finances. Follow for daily updates.
